metadata.title: BOPEU Demo Profiles & Role-Based Experience Pack
metadata.client_demo_warning: All people, identifiers, contact details, accounts, balances, cases, activity and usage metrics are fictional test data. They must not be used for production, payroll, claims, partner verification or actual communications.
metadata.branding_note: Formal working name in the requirements brief is BOPEU Member Services Portal. 'Mmereki' appears as a proposed brand pending BOPEU approval.
data_rules: All Omang references are non-numeric DEMO placeholders and are not valid identity numbers.
Phone numbers are masked with Xs and marked not routable; emails use the reserved .invalid domain.
Bank, wallet, membership, SACCOS, medical-aid, dependant and digital-card references are non-production placeholders.
No passwords, API credentials, token secrets, SIM serials or valid authentication material are included.
Basic salaries, scales, deductions, savings, loan balances, premiums and application amounts are synthetic UI figures, not real payroll or product offers.
The sample 1% subscription calculation is MIN(P100, MAX(P39.90, 1% of synthetic basic salary)); the exact production payroll rules and line items must be signed off by BOPEU.
Where the benefit reference says rates/terms are not public or need confirmation, the profile deliberately shows a pending/verify state rather than inventing a price.
